title: "Yea" to an either/or time gets a blunt correction
whatWentWrong: ZOH asked "About what time do you usually get to the gym after work, like 5:30 or 6?", Yanni said "Yea", and ZOH replied "Ha, I need a number to plan around. Is it closer to 5:30 or 6 when you walk into the gym?"
shouldHaveHappened: After "Yea", ZOH asks once more, kindly: it gives a short reason a set time helps (staying consistent) and asks which works better, 5:30 or 6, without correcting or teasing them (no "Ha, I need a number"). After "I would say 6", it saves 6 pm and moves on to the next thing.
